text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. They say there are bumps on
every road!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've bumped into many telephone poles
from too
much thinking in Bakushin
mode, so it's okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even the greatest experts have their
share of bad
luck! I will take this
experience as a lesson!
